behaviors: Failed writes retain old reported/cached state, release lock, and recover on later save. Real atomic writer fails when its parent is a regular file. Unreadable directory source prevents writer invocation and preserves recoverable child content.

Equal timestamp with changed length invalidates cached reads; existing integration verifies unconditional under-lock reread merges external writes even when timestamp AND length are identical. Existing retry fixture proves intervening writes merge and repeated churn exhausts bounded attempts.

Legacy chmod cases skipped privileged users and Windows. Portable real I/O failures plus injected write failure exercise those failure branches on this host without claiming an ACL/permission simulation.
